nodes.label: GOCOOK Brand Badge
nodes.rationale: Solid #6A3F23 pill (rx 25) with white 700-weight wordmark pinned top-left at x=78,y=77, so every menu cover self-identifies the platform even when cropped into a small card thumbnail.

nodes.label: Price and Servings Line (359.000 đ · 3–4 people)
nodes.norm_label: price and servings line (359.000 đ · 3–4 people)
nodes.rationale: Vietnamese dong formatting (dot thousands separator, spaced "đ") plus an x–y people range, matching how a booking quotes a family-style meal for a household rather than per plate.

nodes.label: Illustrated Rice Plate with Shrimp, Rice Grains and Herb Garnish
nodes.norm_label: illustrated rice plate with shrimp, rice grains and herb garnish
nodes.rationale: Food is drawn procedurally instead of photographed: a #FAFBF5 rimmed bowl (r=197, 21px #E0D9CA stroke) holds a #F0D9A5 rice disc, ~24 rotated #FFF8E5 ellipses as rice grains, 7 rotated #93B57A ellipses as herbs, 5 #DF865A circles as shrimp, a small dark dipping bowl bottom-right, and an 8-lobe #93B57A flower garnish. Rotation angles step by 11/23 degrees so repeated shapes never look like a stamped grid.

nodes.label: "THỰC ĐƠN MINH HỌA · MENU 008" Illustrative-Menu Footer
nodes.norm_label: "thuc đon minh hoa · menu 008" illustrative-menu footer
nodes.rationale: A 22px footer at 65% opacity marks the cover as a sample menu and stamps its sequence id (MENU 008), so demo content is visibly non-binding for real bookings and each seed asset traces back to one row in the seed dataset.

nodes.label: Warm Appetitive Palette (Cocoa / Coral / Herb Green on Cream)
nodes.norm_label: warm appetitive palette (cocoa / coral / herb green on cream)
nodes.rationale: Four-token palette carried across the whole menu-cover series: #6A3F23 cocoa for text and badge, #DF865A coral for accent and shrimp, #93B57A herb green for garnish, and a diagonal #FFF9ED→#FBEEDC cream gradient base. Decoration uses the same hues at opacity .07-.12 so it reads as atmosphere, never competes with the dish name.

nodes.rationale: Every featured dish is a salad, soup or plain grilled protein with vegetables, styled on a bright kitchen table with infused water and berries. nodes.label: Steamed Rice Bowls (Shared Staple)
nodes.rationale: Four individual rice bowls placed around shared plates communicate a family-style / multi-person serving size, the kind of portion information a booking customer reads from a menu photo.

nodes.label: Vegetarian / Plant-Based Cuisine
nodes.rationale: Every plate shown is meat-free (tofu, mushrooms, leafy greens, rice, herbs), so the image encodes the vegetarian category as a filterable attribute on dishes/menus rather than a separate cuisine.

nodes.label: Vietnamese-Style Vegetarian Spread
nodes.rationale: Fresh spring rolls with rice vermicelli, stir-fried water spinach with garlic, mushroom broth, herbs, lime and chilli, and chopstick place settings identify the dish set as Vietnamese home cooking - the marketplace's local cuisine context.

nodes.label: Com Gia Dinh Home-Style Meal Platter
nodes.norm_label: com gia dinh home-style meal platter
nodes.rationale: Cover image stages a complete everyday Vietnamese home meal (protein + vegetable + soup + rice + two dipping sauces) on a woven bamboo tray rather than a single plated dish, signalling portioned family-style cooking and variety to customers browsing chef menus.

nodes.label: Procedural plate illustration (rice grains, herb leaves, sauce bowl, star-cut garnish)
nodes.norm_label: procedural plate illustration (rice grains, herb leaves, sauce bowl, star-cut garnish)
nodes.rationale: Rice plate is built from a 197px circle plus ~24 rotated 12x5 highlight ellipses and scattered 24x12 leaf ellipses and terracotta dots at 0.25 opacity; a second 53px bowl and an 8-petal rotated-ellipse star (okra cross-section) fill the composition without any bitmap asset.

nodes.label: Cover card layout (badge / eyebrow / oversized title / price / caption)
nodes.norm_label: cover card layout (badge / eyebrow / oversized title / price / caption)
nodes.rationale: Text stack is left-aligned on a 80px gutter with a fixed 51px pill badge, 26px letter-spaced category eyebrow, 62px weight-800 two-line title wrapping 'Mâm cơm sườn' / 'rim', 34px price line and a 22px caption; illustration occupies the right half so Vietnamese diacritics and price stay legible at thumbnail scale.

nodes.label: THỰC ĐƠN MINH HỌA (illustrative sample disclaimer)
nodes.norm_label: thuc đon minh hoa (illustrative sample disclaimer)
nodes.rationale: Footer caption in 65%-opacity brown marks the cover as demo/seed data rather than a real chef listing, so users do not book a fictional menu.
